answer.worked:
The leading term is $x^3$, so the curve rises to the right. Its $x$-intercepts are $-1$, $1$ and $4$, and it crosses the axis at each intercept.

The graph is on or below the $x$-axis for $x\le -1$ or $1\le x\le 4$.
